guide.summary: Prototype or own account (Restricted Mode) (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none); Public agent app for many users (app review, wait 2-4 weeks).
guide.verdict: Easiest: Prototype or own account (Restricted Mode) (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none). Hardest: Public agent app for many users (app review, wait 2-4 weeks).

composio.note: Composio has a managed OAuth app for YNAB. For production, create a custom auth config with your own client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Not for prototyping, since Composio manages a YNAB app. For production, yes: users otherwise see Composio's name on the consent screen, and managed quota is shared. Your own app also gets its own review and 25-user cap.
reasons: Users see your app name instead of Composio on the consent screen
Dedicated rate-limit quota instead of shared quota
Control over scopes, such as read-only
Your own Works with YNAB listing and review

scenarios.label: Prototype or own account (Restricted Mode)
scenarios.when_this_applies: You test with your own account and up to 25 other users, or use Composio's managed app.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: No review needed while staying in Restricted Mode.

scenarios.approval: No review while you stay under the Restricted Mode limit of 25 tokens for other users.

scenarios.label: Public agent app for many users
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your production AI agent serves more than 25 outside YNAB users through your own OAuth app.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured; includes privacy policy and review form

scenarios.approval: YNAB reviews the app against its API Terms of Service and OAuth Application Requirements before removing Restricted Mode.
extras: Naming, branding, no copying YNAB, no under-13 apps

modifiers.note: Naming, branding, no copying YNAB, no under-13 apps

prerequisites.title: YNAB account
prerequisites.detail: You need a YNAB account to open Developer Settings. API access fails with 403 if the subscription lapsed or the trial expired.

prerequisites.title: Privacy policy
prerequisites.detail: Publish a privacy policy that explains how API data is handled, stored, secured and kept, with a Last Updated date. YNAB says it does not check legal compliance.

steps.title: Create OAuth app in Developer Settings
steps.detail: Sign in to YNAB, open Developer Settings, click New Application and save. Add your redirect URI. Client ID and secret are shown after saving.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config for the ynab toolkit with your client ID and secret via Composio's API. Request the minimum scope; use read-only if writes are not needed.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection works.

steps.title: Draft and publish privacy policy
steps.detail: Agent drafts the policy covering handling, storage, security, retention and a Last Updated date. You review and publish it, and show its URL in the OAuth client configuration.
steps.done_when: Policy is live and linked in the app configuration.

steps.title: Check naming and branding
steps.detail: Check that app name and domain use 'for YNAB' if they mention YNAB, and that no YNAB artwork is modified.
steps.done_when: Names and graphics follow YNAB rules.

steps.title: Submit review request form
steps.detail: Submit YNAB's review form to have Restricted Mode removed.

steps.title: Wait for YNAB review
steps.detail: YNAB reviews against its policies and emails you when Restricted Mode is removed. The documented time is 2-4 weeks.

traps.title: 25-user cap blocks new sign-ups
traps.detail: Once 25 other users have authorized, new authorizations are blocked and a message appears on the Authorization screen. Start the review before launch.

traps.title: Implicit grant tokens expire in 2 hours
traps.detail: The Implicit Grant gives no refresh tokens, so users must re-authorize after 2 hours. Use the authorization code flow for an agent.

traps.title: Managed app shows Composio's name
traps.detail: With the managed app users see 'Composio wants to access your account'. Managed quota is also shared across Composio users.

traps.title: Naming rules
traps.detail: App name and domain may not include YNAB or You Need A Budget unless preceded by 'for'. Breaking the rules can get the app disabled.

traps.title: Rate limit of 200 requests per hour
traps.detail: Each access token may be used for up to 200 requests per hour. Plan agent call volume accordingly.

blockers.symptom: Authorization screen shows a limit message and new users cannot authorize
blockers.what_it_means: Your app reached the 25-token Restricted Mode cap.
blockers.what_to_do: Request the YNAB review and wait for Restricted Mode removal.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the privacy policy and check the app against the requirements before you submit.

blockers.what_it_means: The user's subscription lapsed or trial expired. A read-only token also gets 403 on write endpoints.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the user to renew, or request a write-capable scope if writes are needed.
blockers.agent_can_help: Surface a clear message to the user based on the error.

open_questions: Does the review check a working demo or other items beyond policy compliance? Ask YNAB via the review form or API support.
Is the 2-4 week review time current and does it include resubmissions? Ask YNAB support.
Does the 25-token cap count re-authorizations by the same user? Test or ask YNAB.
Does the Composio managed app share one 25-token cap across all Composio users? Ask Composio support.
